tasks.title: Verify a controlled existing-file change
tasks.goal: Use the accepted transition law to prove new source is actually built and tested.
steps: Consume M-11-D pre/post transition implementation; do not redeclare its ownership law.
Create and explicitly adopt variants of one existing-source edit, retaining pre-images, write set and post witnesses.
Run deterministic build/test over the post-source, then verify transition/current outputs; repeat verify without new production.
positive_cases: Both executed and explicitly adopted output paths retain truthful authority.
New source tests run and a second verify reuses production.
negative_cases: Outside-write edit, lost pre-image or changed consumed artifact refuses.
Old-source test evidence cannot accept the edited source.
